tldr: Jupiter in the 7th house: growth becomes personal through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
body:
With Jupiter in the 7th house, this part of you expands through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict. Jupiter describes growth, faith, appetite, opportunity, generosity, and the need for a wider view. In practice, this brings attention to the one-to-one dynamics that show you how you meet others and how you let yourself be met.

When this placement is supported, relationship patterns can become clearer while there is still room to choose differently. Jupiter can become hope, confidence, perspective, generosity, and a larger sense of possibility.

When it is strained, you may hand too much power to the other person or make them carry the whole story. The harder pattern can show up as overextension, excess, overpromising, or assuming more is always better.
gift: hope, confidence, perspective, generosity, and a larger sense of possibility expressed through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
challenge: overextension, excess, overpromising, or assuming more is always better around partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
